latestAction.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs.

aiDescription.summary: The bill raises Section 3(b)'s Regulation A exemption from $50 million to $150 million and requires the SEC to adjust it biennially for CPI‑U inflation to the nearest $10,000. It covers issuers using the Section 3(b)/Regulation A exemption for small‑company offerings and updates related paragraph references to incorporate the inflation adjustment.

impact.summary: The bill raises the Regulation A offering cap from $50 million to $150 million and requires the Securities and Exchange Commission to adjust it for CPI every two years to the nearest $10,000. It affects small companies and startups using Regulation A, their investors, and SEC oversight duties.
